summary: Veterinary centre directory. Migration 0022 adds centre with its type, services, amenities, species, members and hours, and — instead of a second location table — makes vet_location.vet_account_id nullable and adds centre_id and is_open_24h, so a branch is the same Phase 1 row (P2-D15, DEC-0167). A branch created for a centre has no veterinarian, no licence and no capability, so the Finder and every Phase 1 flow (which join on that account) never see it; an existing veterinarian's place joins a centre by link, keeping its licence, capabilities and Finder position untouched. The superadmin records centres and their branches at /admin/centres, the review operator publishes, hides and records the licence at /review/centres, and the managing account edits its own centre at /account/centres; the licence is the Verification axis and its owner never records it. Announced weekday hours and a 24-hour flag are information only (P2-D08). A veterinarian invited to the professional team appears on the page only after accepting from their own profile. Publishing needs a description and a public branch with a city — or, for an unowned reviewed record, a city. The public /centers list filters by type, service, species, province, city, round-the-clock and recorded licence, and /centers/[slug] shows branches with hours, team, amenities and VeterinaryCare JSON-LD.

limitations: Centre images (§9) were not built: the public image pipeline today serves content images only (DEC-0160), so adding centre media needs its own purpose and review path.
Suggestion by an ordinary user and the manager's claim of a centre (§10) arrive with PROMPT-009; until then the superadmin hands over management with a reason and an audit entry.
A branch shows its recorded coordinates as text: no map provider is configured and the map belongs to PROMPT-015.
Linking an existing veterinarian's place to a centre is a superadmin action; a veterinarian cannot attach their own place from their profile yet.
Reporting a centre profile (§13) and merging duplicate centres (§21) belong to PROMPT-016; advertising packages to PROMPT-011 and ranking and search to PROMPT-012.
Nothing here reserves a time: announced hours and the 24-hour flag are information only (P2-D08).
Browser and unit/DB checks were targeted by user instruction; unaffected suites were last run in full at commit 7c74577.
Visual fidelity of the centre pages is UNVERIFIED: no Phase 2 Figma frame is in the sources.
